description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named LeaveWithDaysLeft, representing leave information including id, date, duration, status, leave type, employee number, and remaining days left for leave.

classes.name: LeaveWithDaysLeft
classes.description: A data transfer object encapsulating leave details with remaining days left for an employee.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize all properties of the leave DTO, with optional daysLeft defaulting to 0.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the leave.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the leave.

methods.name: getLengthHours
methods.description: Returns the length of leave in hours.

methods.name: setLengthHours
methods.description: Sets the length of leave in hours.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the length of leave in days.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the length of leave in days.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the leave.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the leave.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the leave.

methods.name: getDaysLeft
methods.description: Returns the number of days left of leave.

methods.name: setDaysLeft
methods.description: Sets the number of days left of leave.
